svg.title: Two ways to find the rollback instructions
svg.desc: Illustrative comparison. Vector RAG ranks passages by semantic similarity and reads selected passages. PageIndex follows a handbook tree from Delivery to Rollback and reads the source page. Both need source evidence before answering.

path.aria-label: How do I undo a bad deployment?
Same question. Different way to find the pages.
The tree guides the search. The page supports the answer.
